children: Archer announced the HSR Act waiting period has expired for its acquisition of Boeing’s Wisk Aero, Insitu and SkyGrid subsidiaries.
Hart-Scott-Rodino waiting period expired Sept 18, 2026, satisfying a key closing condition.
Acquisition remains subject to other closing conditions and required regulatory approvals.
Transaction expected to close by the end of 2026, per the press release.
Deal combines Wisk, Insitu and SkyGrid technologies with Archer’s products and AI foundation model ZEE.
